lastResponse.text: Yes. Try Safe Place for Youth (ages 12 to 20). They can help with shelter, transportation, and basic needs. Call five zero three, five four two, two seven one seven. I’ll repeat: 5-0-3, 5-4-2, 2-7-1-7. Backup number: five zero three, five four two, two three eight nine. You can ask, “I’m 16 and need a safe Place tonight. Can I get help without contacting my parents right away?” If someone is pressuring you now or blocking you from leaving, call nine one one immediately.
originalTexts: Yes. Try **Safe Place for Youth** (ages 12 to 20). They can help with shelter, transportation, and basic needs. Call **503-542-2717**. I’ll repeat: **5-0-3, 5-4-2, 2-7-1-7**. Backup number: **503-542-2389**. You can ask, “I’m 16 and need a safe place tonight. Can I get help without contacting my parents right away?” If someone is pressuring you now or blocking you from leaving, call **911** immediately.
